detail.en: IATA advises against transporting snub-nosed dogs in hot season.
detail.fr: L'IATA déconseille le transport des chiens au museau écrasé en saison chaude.
detail.es: La IATA desaconseja transportar perros de hocico chato en temporada calurosa.
detail.pt: A IATA desaconselha o transporte de cães de focinho achatado em época quente.

source.quote: Transport of snub nose dogs, such as boxers, pugs, bulldogs and Pekinese, in hot season is not recommended.
